To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the W3C provenance model can be used to model provenance for software development processes, (2) provenance graphs can be used to gain insight into software processes and (3) provenance graphs provide a good basis for the generation of knowledge graphs for the domain of software development.
we can model provenance graphs of software processes using a data model, and that these graphs can be analyzed to get insights into the processes.
provenance graphs are a suitable data model for knowledge representation in software processes, and that they can be used for process analysis.
